name: I-acne
tagline: Kuyalapheka. Ungakhethi. Bonana nodokotela ukuze uthole izinkinga.

what_is_it.heading: Izinduna ngamagama alula
what_is_it.lede: Izinduna yilokho okwenzekayo lapho amafutha namaseli esikhumba afile evimba izimbotshana. Kwesinye isikhathi imbobo evalekile ivuvukala amagciwane esikhumba ajwayelekile - yilapho uthola khona amabala abomvu, abuhlungu. Akubangwa ukungcola.
paragraphs: Izinduna zivame kakhulu entsheni ngoba izinguquko zamahomoni zandisa ukukhiqizwa kukawoyela. Kodwa nabantu abadala bayayithola - ikakhulukazi abesifazane abaneminyaka engu-20 no-30, ngokuvamile eduze komhlathi. Cishe u-85% wabantu baseNingizimu Afrika uzoba nezinduna ngesinye isikhathi.

Izinduna ezithambile ngokuvamile ziphendula ekwelapheni okuthe xaxa kanye nemikhuba emihle yesikhumba. Izinduna ezimaphakathi ukuya kwezinzima - ikakhulukazi ezinamaqhubu, izibazi, noma ubuhlungu - zidinga udokotela. Imithi esebenzayo kadokotela ikhona. Izinduna ezinzima ezingalashwa zingashiya izibazi ezingapheli futhi zithinte ukuzethemba iminyaka.

items.body: Kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika bathola izinduna ngesinye isikhathi. Kungesinye sezimo zesikhumba ezivame kakhulu emhlabeni.

items.headline: Kuyalapheka
items.body: Ngisho nezinduna ezinzima zisabela ekwelashweni kwesimanje. Uma uqala kusenesikhathi, kuzoncipha izibazi oyohlala nazo.

items.headline: Ungakhethi
items.body: Ukukha, ukukhama, nokukhuhla kanzima kwenza izinduna zibe zimbi kakhulu futhi kubangele izibazi ezingapheli. Umkhuba onzima ukwephula - futhi okubaluleke kakhulu.

items.headline: Akulona iphutha lakho
items.body: Izinduna azibangelwa ukungcola, ukudla ushokoledi, nanoma yini oyenzile. Ikakhulukazi amahomoni kanye nezakhi zofuzo.

pull_quote.text: Isinyathelo esisodwa esinamandla ekwelapheni izinduna siqala kusenesikhathi - ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale isibazi. Uma ukwelapha ngaphandle kwekhawunta kungasebenzi ngemva kwamaviki angu-8, bonana nodokotela.

signs.heading: Izinhlobo zezinduna - nokuthi zingathí sina kangakanani
signs.lede: Izinduna zisukela ezindaweni ezimbalwa kuye kumathumba ajulile, abuhlungu. Uhlobo lubalulekile ngoba lushintsha indlela yokwelapha.

items.title: Okuphansi — ama-blackhead nama-whitehead
items.description: Amaqhubu amancane ngaphandle kokuvuvukala okuningi. Ivamise ukuphendula ekunakekelweni kwesikhumba okuhle kanye nemikhiqizo ethengwayo. Zama i-benzoyl peroxide noma i-salicylic acid kuqala.

items.title: Okulingene - amabala abomvu, avuvukele
items.description: Ama-papules abomvu nama-pustules ebusweni, esifubeni, emuva. Zama ukwelashwa ngaphandle kwekhawunta amaviki angu-8. Uma kungekho ngcono - bonana nodokotela. Izinketho zemithi kadokotela zisebenza kangcono.

items.title: Okubi - ama-cysts kanye nezibazi
items.description: Izigaxa ezijulile, ezibuhlungu ezihlala amasonto. Ishiya izibazi. Bonana nodokotela ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka. I-Isotretinoin (i-Roaccutane) iphumelela kakhulu kulokhu.

items.myth: Ushokoledi, ukudla okunamafutha, noshukela kubangela izinduna.
items.fact: Ubufakazi bubuthakathaka futhi buhluka phakathi kwabantu. Ukudla okunoshukela omningi/okunobisi oluningi kungase kwenze izinduna zibe zimbi kakhulu kwezinye, kodwa azibangeli. Ama-hormone nezakhi zofuzo kubaluleke kakhulu.

items.myth: Geza ubuso bakho kakhulu — lokho kuzokusula.
items.fact: Ukugeza ngokweqile kuyoma futhi kucasule isikhumba, okwenza izinduna zibe zimbi kakhulu. Ukuhlanza okumnene kabili ngosuku kwanele. Izikhuhla eziqinile zishisa isikhumba futhi zibe bomvu kakhulu.

items.myth: Umuthi wokuxubha, ujusi kalamula, kanye ne-bicarb kusebenza njengokwelashwa kwasekhaya.
items.fact: Konke kungacunula noma kushise isikhumba futhi kubhebhethekise izibazi. Sebenzisa imikhiqizo efanele yezinduna - i-benzoyl peroxide, i-salicylic acid, i-retinoids - eyenzelwe ukusebenza ngokuphepha.

Ukushuka kungamisa isikhumba okwesikhashana, kwenze amabala angabonakali. Isikhathi eside, ukulimala kwelanga kwandisa izibazi futhi kwandisa isikhumba sakho. Yelapha izinduna — vikela isikhumba sakho.

prevention.heading: Imikhuba yansuku zonke esiza
prevention.lede: Awukwazi ukuvimbela ngokuphelele izinduna - kodwa unganciphisa ukuqubuka, ukwesekwa kokwelashwa, futhi uvimbele izibazi.

items.title: Ukuhlanza okumnene kabili ngosuku
items.description: Morning and evening — amanzi-based, amakha-free. Ungakhuhli. Ungasebenzisi insipho yebha noma izikhuhla eziqinile esikhumbeni esithandwa yizinduna.

items.title: I-SPF engeyona i-comedogenic nsuku zonke
items.description: Ukuvikela ilanga kubalulekile ngisho nezinduna. Bheka i-'non-comedogenic' (ngeke ivimbe izimbotshana) kulebula. Imikhiqizo eminingi emikhulu inalawa.

items.title: Ungakhethi — ungamimi
items.description: Ukukha kuphusha ukutheleleka kujule futhi kuphendule amabala abe yizibazi. Uphawu oluvela endaweni ekhethiwe lungahlala izinyanga eziyisi-6. Umaki osuka endaweni engakwesokunxele - mhlawumbe amaviki ama-2.

items.title: Nikeza ukwelashwa amaviki angu-8
items.description: Ukwelashwa kwezinduna kuthatha amaviki angu-6-12 ukukhombisa umphumela ogcwele. Ungashintshi njalo ezinsukwini ezimbalwa. Namathela endleleni eyodwa futhi wahlulele ngamamaki wamaviki angu-8.

items.title: Qala nge-over-the-counter ukuze uthole izinduna ezithambile
items.description: I-Benzoyl peroxide 2.5% ijeli noma i-salicylic acid yokugeza. Sebenzisa kanye ngosuku isonto lonke, bese kabili uma ubekezelelwe. Itholakala kunoma yiliphi ikhemisi ngaphandle kwencwadi kadokotela.

items.title: Uma kungekho ngcono ngemva kwamasonto angu-8 - bonana nodokotela
items.description: Kumahhala kunoma yimuphi umtholampilo kahulumeni. Imithi ye-retinoid ye-topical kanye nama-antibiotics asebenza kangcono kakhulu kune-OTC ye-acne emaphakathi.

items.title: Uma kunzima noma kunezibazi - bheka maduze
items.description: I-cystic acne enzima ingashiya izibazi ezihlala njalo. Ukwelashwa okufana ne-isotretinoin (i-Roaccutane) kusebenza kahle kakhulu. Imitholampilo kahulumeni ingadlulisela kudokotela wesikhumba.

items.title: Phatha yonke indawo, hhayi nje amabala
items.description: Faka imithi yokwelapha kancane endaweni ethintekile - hhayi nje ezindaweni ezingazodwana. Igwema ukuqubuka okulandelayo esikhundleni sokubamba.

items.title: Vikela isikhumba sakho elangeni
items.description: Ukwelashwa kwezinduna kwenza isikhumba singazweli elangeni. Sebenzisa i-SPF engeyona i-comedogenic 30+ nsuku zonke. Ilanga liphinde lenze amamaki amnyama ashiywe amachashaza adlule.

get_help.heading: Lapho okumele uye khona
get_help.lede: Izinduna eziningi zingelashwa ekhaya noma emtholampilo wokunakekelwa okuyisisekelo. Izinzuzo zezinduna ezinzima ekudlulisweni kwe-dermatology - kutholakala ohlelweni lomphakathi.

helplines.name: Noma yiliphi ikhemisi lendawo
helplines.description: Ngaphandle kwe-counter benzoyl peroxide, i-salicylic acid, okhilimu be-retinoid
